children.name: difference_due
children.description:
The difference due of the order exchange.

- If less than `0`, the merchant owes the customer this amount.
- If greater than `0`, the customer owes the merchange this amount.
- If equal to `0`, no payment is required by either sides.

children.name: raw_difference_due

- If greater than `0`, the customer owes the merchange this amount.
- If equal to `0`, no payment is required by either sides.

children.name: action_id
children.description:
The ID of the action associated with the item to remove.
Every item has an `actions` property, whose value is an array of actions.
You can find the action with the name `ITEM_ADD` using the item's `action` property,
and use the value of the action's `id` property.
